problems: Round 2's look regression is fixed. I compared every clip in all 27 GLBs (dist-catalog vs ./deploy, live 2026.11.18). I wrote my own gltf-transform script for this. It samples every rotation track at 60 fps and also checks translations and clip lengths. Only 34 clips differ from live. 32 are the re-keyed attack and cast clips. The other two are Ulkro's idle_lobby (worst 3.7 deg, neck) and victory (worst 3.6 deg, foot.L). Every idle, idle_lobby, victory, recall, channel, death and run on the other 15 fighters is within 0.5 deg of live: Burdam's idle_lobby, victory, recall and channel are 0.3-0.5 deg off, Rishal's idle_lobby 0.5 deg, and all the rest 0.0. No translation or clip length changed outside the re-keys. The CC clips (stunned, airborne, sleep and the others) are byte-identical in motion. Hesmi, Burdam, Ervet and Rishal now carry no walk clip. The twelve other fighters gain one walk clip each, and no clip was removed.

Plinth, looked at frame by frame. I rendered the menu idle_lobby with the same code on a HEAD-catalog server and a live-catalog server. The clip time was set exactly and every frame was rendered at 1600x900. Burdam on Home at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 1.9, 2, 2.5, 2.93 and 3.5 s: the poses match live. At 1.9-2.93 s he raises the blade upright and inspects it, as on live. 0-445 px differ by more than 24/255, all along the body's edges. Burdam on the lobby station gave the same result. Rishal: 1-616 px differ, and the pose is the same. Ulkro: 3.1k-5.1k px differ at 0.5-2.2 s and 14 px at 3.0-3.6 s. Side by side, the stance, the spear angle and the hand on the hip are the same, and I could not see a difference. Round 2's blade-flat-across-the-chest regression is gone.

The pump and the taunt tug now move on the four no-walk bodies. I used the real renderer with the real sim (status.ts haste and taunt), 110 run frames each. Hasted at 1.66-1.69 runRef: Hesmi, Burdam and Ervet go through 3.8-4.6 locoPhase cycles with wHaste 0.90-0.96. The upper arm's swing grows from 68 to 106 deg on Burdam, from 101 to 112 deg on Hesmi and from 8 to 14 deg on Ervet. Rishal only reached 1.36 runRef with haste 0.7, so his wHaste is 0.14 by design (the layer starts at 1.3 runRef), and his phase still cycles 4.6 times. When taunted, all four step through 2.2-2.7 cycles at wTaunt 1.0. Before this round, the phase was frozen at 0 on these four.

Slowed foot slip in the renderer. A slowed fighter walks 30 m straight at 1/60 s. Slip is the planted part's travel over each contact span divided by the body's travel, with the contact taken at the 5th percentile of height + 3 cm for at least 4 frames. HEAD code on the HEAD catalog vs the same code on the live catalog. The four no-walk bodies give the same numbers to 0.1 on both catalogs, so they play live's run. Toe-based medians: Hesmi 8.7-9.3 %, Burdam 6.2-7.0 %, Ervet 16.2-16.9 %, Rishal 36.5-44.4 %. Ervet and Rishal are over the 10 % bar, but they are exactly live (the r2 verifier's ankle metric put Ervet near 5 %). Blending bodies at 0.38-0.58 runRef, HEAD [live]: Lisvel 4.7-5.5 [3.7-3.9], Tunlan 3.2-5.0 [3.4-3.6], Dunsom 1.2-4.4 [2.6-2.9], Odrum 5.7 [3.0-3.1], Kemdo 6.9 [0.6-1.2]. All are under 10 %.

Minor: two metrics disagree on Kemdo. On the toe, Kemdo's walk is 5.7-6.3 points worse than his live slowed run, which is past the 3-point bar. On the ankle (foot bone), measured the same way, the walk is much better than live: Kemdo 2.4-3.1 % vs 20.5 %, Odrum 2.0 % vs 6.1-6.7 %, Lisvel 4.7-5.1 % vs 6.5-7.4 %. So the walk plants the ankle and rolls the toe a little, while the live run slides the whole foot. Under Kemdo's robe at the 31 m camera, the ankle is what reads. I do not count this as a regression a player would notice.

CC states at the 31 m RIFT camera. I ran _harness/w3b_cc_strip.mjs --game on HEAD at 0.3, 0.7 and 1.2 s. Burdam stun, Kemdo airborne, Hesmi sleep, Lisvel fear, Rishal taunt, Tunlan root and Odrum slowed walk each play their intended role. No body or face is broken in any frame. Readability is as round 2 found it: airborne and taunt read from the body, while stun, sleep and root lean on their VFX, as on live.

Re-keyed attacks at the map camera, HEAD vs live catalog, same sim, 9 frames 0.1 s apart. Ervet cast_ult and Nurrow cast_ult differ only in the wind-up arm and blade (frames at 0.1-0.36 s), and the dash and impact frames match. Burdam and Lisvel auto-attacks rolled attack2, which is not re-keyed, and are identical. Nothing is broken or reads worse. The FU-8 misses from rounds 1-2 still stand and are minor: Ervet ult and Lisvel attack1 have no counter-twist, and Ardit attack2 and Rishal crit are under the 1.2 m strike.

Out of scope, by the lead's decision, and not scored: the hasted longer stride, FU-12 value zones, the FU-13 Wick value step, units_gate and Wick contrast. None of them changed, so the Wicks are as on live.

shipNotes: 0b879c893 closes round 2's findings. Burdam's and Rishal's menu loops are back to live (<= 0.5 deg), and Ulkro's are within 3.7 deg, which I could not see on the plinth. The four no-walk bodies drop their unused walk and play live's run exactly. Their hasted pump and taunt tug now step with the feet. Every non-re-keyed clip on every fighter is live within 0.5 deg, apart from Ulkro's two menu loops. The lane is safe to ship as a whole: the walk on twelve bodies, the CC body layers and ccKindOf, the 32 line-of-action re-keys, and this round. Bytes are +110.6 KB raw (+24 KB on the wire for the whole roster) and every file is <= 1172 KiB. Load, programs and frame times show no regression against ./deploy. Follow-ups, none blocking: Rishal's and Ervet's slowed run (live behaviour) are the worst in the roster, and a walk for the four should start with them. Kemdo's walk rolls the toe about 6 % (the ankle is planted). The FU-8 counter-twist and strike-length misses stand. 0b879c893 also edited _harness/probe_fighter_motion.ts and art/blender/common/anim.py (NO_WALK), outside the file list. Both are consistent with ruling 70.
